text:
maria-sales: Hey team — customer (FSI bank) wants clarity on POC deliverables for an on‑prem air‑gapped site. They expect bootable media + signed bundles and offline license activation. Can we confirm delivery timing, signing process, whether HSM-backed keys are possible, cert rotation cadence, delta updates, and any commercial fees? POC target week of May 12. Anyone?

alex-ops: We can produce bootable USB/SSD images. Need to know image size (model + runtime). For a quantized 30GB model we usually do signed tarball + signed manifest. Lead time: ~5–7 business days from final build signoff for USB/SSD. If they want encrypted media + tamper-evident packaging add ~2 days.

jordan-eng: For KMS/HSM: private deployments support customer‑managed KMS. For airgap we typically sign bundles with our key and give a verification tool so the customer can validate offline. If they require BYO‑HSM for signing, that’s supported but needs extra onboarding and attestation. Cert rotation: recommend 90d in prod, but we can do 1yr for POC; rotation implies producing a new signed bundle + operator runbook.

kim-security: Need to see their security questionnaire for specifics on key custody. If they insist on BYO‑HSM we require attestation and a short integration plan. Offline license activation: we provide one‑time activation tokens + a local license server container that validates tokens offline. That flow is auditable.

paul-account: Commercial note — physical media + secure signing is a fixed fee + shipping. If they want delta update management for airgapped nodes there’s an ops support add‑on.

maria-sales: Two clarifying questions from the customer: 1) Can they apply in‑field minor fixes (hotfixes) without shipping a full image? 2) What’s the rollback path if an upgrade fails?

alex-ops: Yes — we support signed delta patch bundles containing engine + weights diffs for minor fixes. For major quantization changes we recommend a full image. For upgrade failure: the installer has health checks and automatic rollback to the previous image if checks fail during boot/post‑install. Manifest must include a rollback marker.

jordan-eng: Delta updates for quantized weights are tricky — binary diffs can blow up if layout changes. We’ll provide signed manifests + checksums. Example manifest snippet we use for verification: ```{"files": [{"path": "model.bin", "sha256": "<sha256>"}], "rollback": true}```. The verification CLI will reject mismatched signatures.

kim-security: Also call out chain of custody: we provide a signing workflow and verification steps for the customer runbook. They usually want SHA‑256 and signature verification as part of acceptance.

maria-sales: @paul-account can you confirm the fee range so I can tell the customer? @jordan-eng please draft a short acceptance checklist I can share.

paul-account: Estimate: $3,000 one‑time for media + signing, $250 standard shipping; rush shipping + packaging is ~+$750. Delta update management + on‑call during POC is a $5,000 add‑on. Final pricing to be in SOW.

jordan-eng: POC acceptance checklist suggestion (short): - Device boots and verifies signature - Model binary loads within 5m after first boot - Inference p95 <150ms over 1k queries - Offline license activation completes <10m - Apply signed delta update and demonstrate rollback. I’ll put that in a one‑pager and link it.

maria-sales: Great. Last thing — customer prefers annual cert validity. Is that acceptable for POC?

kim-security: Annual certs OK for a POC only. For production we insist on 90d or compensating controls. We’ll document exceptions in the security questionnaire response.

sam-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new artifact signed by CI at 1795012300, manifest v1.2 attached to release-1234.

maria-sales: Thanks all — I’ll relay this to the customer and ask them to upload the security questionnaire. Scheduling a technical call Tues 10am PT to walk through acceptance criteria and packaging options. Tagging @jordan-eng @alex-ops for the call.
